items.answer: Nobody called, did they?
items.audioText: Nobody called, did they?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: nobody הופך את המשפט לשלילי, לכן ה־tag חיובי: did they? משתמשים ב־they עבור nobody ו־somebody.
explanation.en: nobody makes the sentence negative, so the tag is positive. Use they for nobody and somebody.

items.answer: My father is an engineer.
items.audioText: My father is an engineer.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My father is

explanation.he: בעברית 'אבא שלי מהנדס'. באנגלית חובה a/an לפני מקצוע. לפני צליל תנועה: an engineer.
explanation.en: Hebrew has no a. In English a job needs a/an. Before a vowel sound: an engineer.

items.answer: She wants to be a doctor.
items.audioText: She wants to be a doctor.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She wants to

explanation.he: לפני מקצוע ביחיד שמים a או an. doctor מתחיל בעיצור: a doctor.
explanation.en: Put a or an before a singular job. doctor starts with a consonant: a doctor.

items.answer: I think life is beautiful.
items.audioText: I think life is beautiful.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I think life

explanation.he: בעברית 'החיים יפים', עם ה'. באנגלית על דבר כללי לא שמים the: Life is beautiful.
explanation.en: Hebrew says 'the life'. In English, general ideas take no article: Life is beautiful.

alternatives: Life is beautiful, I think.

items.answer: I need some information about the trip.
items.audioText: I need some information about the trip.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I need some information
hints.en: The first half: I need some information

explanation.he: information לא נספר: אין an information ואין informations. אומרים some information או a piece of information.
explanation.en: information is uncountable: not an information. Say some information or a piece of information.

items.answer: Can you give me some advice?
items.audioText: Can you give me some advice?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Can you give

explanation.he: בעברית 'עצה' נספרת, אבל באנגלית advice לא נספר: some advice, a piece of advice. לא an advice.
explanation.en: In Hebrew עצה is countable, but advice is uncountable in English: some advice, not an advice.

items.answer: The moon goes around the Earth.
items.audioText: The moon goes around the Earth.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The moon goes

explanation.he: דבר שיש רק אחד כמוהו מקבל the: the moon, the sun, the sky.
explanation.en: Something unique takes the: the moon, the sun, the sky.

items.answer: I love music, especially jazz.
items.audioText: I love music, especially jazz.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I love music,

explanation.he: בעברית 'אני אוהב/ת את המוזיקה'. באנגלית על דבר כללי: I love music, בלי the.
explanation.en: In English, general nouns take no article: I love music.

items.answer: She is an honest person.
items.audioText: She is an honest person.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She is an

explanation.he: בוחרים a או an לפי הצליל, לא לפי האות. ב־honest ה־h שקטה: an honest person.
explanation.en: Choose a or an by sound, not by letter. The h in honest is silent: an honest person.

items.answer: He is a university student.
items.audioText: He is a university student.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: He is a

explanation.he: הצליל קובע: university נשמע 'יוניברסיטי', ולכן a university.
explanation.en: The sound decides: university starts with a 'y' sound, so a university.

items.answer: Israel is a small country.
items.audioText: Israel is a small country.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Israel is a

explanation.he: שמות של מדינות, ערים ואנשים בדרך כלל בלי the: Israel, France, Haifa. יוצאי דופן: the USA, the UK.
explanation.en: Names of countries, cities and people usually take no the. Exceptions: the USA, the UK.

items.answer: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
items.audioText: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Mount Everest is the highest
hints.en: The first half: Mount Everest is the highest

explanation.he: לפני סופרלטיב תמיד the: the highest, the best, the most interesting.
explanation.en: Superlatives always take the: the highest, the best.

alternatives: The highest mountain in the world is Mount Everest.

items.answer: My birthday is in May.
items.audioText: My birthday is in May.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My birthday is

explanation.he: in לחודשים, שנים ועונות: in May, in 2015, in summer.
explanation.en: in for months, years and seasons.

items.answer: The lesson starts at 8 o'clock.
items.audioText: The lesson starts at 8 o'clock.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The lesson starts

explanation.he: at לשעה מדויקת: at 8 o'clock, at noon, at midnight.
explanation.en: at for clock times.

alternatives: At 8 o'clock the lesson starts.

items.answer: We have a test on Monday.
items.audioText: We have a test on Monday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We have a

explanation.he: on לימים ולתאריכים: on Monday, on 5 June, on my birthday.
explanation.en: on for days and dates.

alternatives: On Monday we have a test.

items.answer: I was born in 2010.
items.audioText: I was born in 2010.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I was born

explanation.he: in לשנים: in 2010. אבל on לתאריך מלא: on 3 March 2010.
explanation.en: in for years. But on for a full date: on 3 March 2010.

alternatives: In 2010 I was born.

items.answer: The keys are on the table.
items.audioText: The keys are on the table.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The keys are

explanation.he: on = על משטח: on the table, on the wall, on the floor.
explanation.en: on = on a surface.

items.answer: She lives in Ashdod.
items.audioText: She lives in Ashdod.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: in לעיר או מדינה: in Ashdod, in Israel.
explanation.en: in for cities and countries.

items.answer: Let's meet at the bus stop.
items.audioText: Let's meet at the bus stop.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Let's meet at

explanation.he: at לנקודה או מקום מסוים: at the bus stop, at the door, at school.
explanation.en: at for a point or specific place.

items.answer: Are you interested in science?
items.audioText: Are you interested in science?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Are you interested

explanation.he: interested in. מילות יחס אחרי שמות תואר צריך ללמוד כצמד: interested in, good at, afraid of.
explanation.en: interested in. Learn adjectives with their prepositions as pairs.

items.answer: Shira is very good at math.
items.audioText: Shira is very good at math.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Shira is very

explanation.he: good at, bad at. בעברית 'טוב ב', אבל באנגלית אומרים good at math.
explanation.en: good at, bad at. Hebrew uses ב, but English says good at.

items.answer: It depends on the weather.
items.audioText: It depends on the weather.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: It depends on

explanation.he: depend on: It depends on the weather. כדאי לזכור כצמד.
explanation.en: depend on: learn it as a pair.

items.answer: I'm afraid of spiders.
items.audioText: I'm afraid of spiders.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: afraid of. בעברית 'מ', ולכן הרבה אומרים from, אבל באנגלית afraid of spiders.
explanation.en: afraid of. Hebrew uses מ, so learners say from, but English says afraid of.

items.answer: We arrived at the airport at six.
items.audioText: We arrived at the airport at six.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We arrived at the
hints.en: The first half: We arrived at the

explanation.he: arrive at the airport, arrive in London. לא arrive to, למרות ש־go to.
explanation.en: arrive at the airport, arrive in London. Never arrive to, even though we say go to.

alternatives: At six we arrived at the airport.

items.answer: She is married to a doctor.
items.audioText: She is married to a doctor.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She is married

explanation.he: married to: She is married to a doctor. לא married with.
explanation.en: married to, not married with.

items.answer: Thank you for your help.
items.audioText: Thank you for your help.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Thank you for

explanation.he: thank you for + שם עצם או ing: Thank you for your help. Thank you for coming.
explanation.en: thank you for + noun or -ing.

items.answer: He apologized for being late.
items.audioText: He apologized for being late.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: He apologized for

explanation.he: apologize for + ing: He apologized for being late. בעברית 'על', באנגלית for.
explanation.en: apologize for + -ing.

items.answer: Who is responsible for this project?
items.audioText: Who is responsible for this project?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Who is responsible

explanation.he: responsible for. בעברית 'אחראי על', ולכן קל לטעות ב־on.
explanation.en: responsible for. Hebrew uses על, so learners say on.

items.answer: We met in the morning.
items.audioText: We met in the morning.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We met in

explanation.he: in the morning / afternoon / evening. יוצא דופן: at night.
explanation.en: in the morning / afternoon / evening. Exception: at night.

alternatives: In the morning we met.

items.answer: I'm waiting for the bus.
items.audioText: I'm waiting for the bus.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I'm waiting for

explanation.he: wait for: I'm waiting for the bus. בעברית 'מחכה ל', אבל באנגלית for.
explanation.en: wait for. Hebrew uses ל, but English uses for.

items.answer: How many brothers do you have?
items.audioText: How many brothers do you have?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: How many brothers

explanation.he: How many + רבים נספרים: How many brothers? How much + דבר שלא סופרים: How much water?
explanation.en: How many + countable plural. How much + uncountable.

items.answer: We don't have much time.
items.audioText: We don't have much time.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We don't have

explanation.he: much עם דבר שלא סופרים, בעיקר בשלילה ובשאלה: We don't have much time.
explanation.en: much with uncountable nouns, especially in negatives and questions.

items.answer: There are some apples in the fridge. Do you want one?
items.audioText: There are some apples in the fridge. Do you want one?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: There are some apples in the
hints.en: The first half: There are some apples in the

explanation.he: some במשפט חיובי: There are some apples. any בשלילה: There aren't any apples.
explanation.en: some in positive sentences, any in negatives.

alternatives: In the fridge there are some apples. Do you want one?

items.answer: There isn't any milk left.
items.audioText: There isn't any milk left.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: There isn't any

explanation.he: בשלילה משתמשים ב־any: There isn't any milk.
explanation.en: In negatives use any.

items.answer: How much money do you need?
items.audioText: How much money do you need?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: How much money

explanation.he: money לא נספר (סופרים shekels, לא money), ולכן How much money?
explanation.en: money is uncountable (we count shekels, not money), so How much money?

items.answer: She has a lot of books in her room.
items.audioText: She has a lot of books in her room.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She has a lot of
hints.en: The first half: She has a lot of

explanation.he: a lot of מתאים לכל סוג של שם עצם במשפט חיובי. לפני שם עצם צריך of: a lot of books.
explanation.en: a lot of works with all nouns in positive sentences. Before a noun, you need of.

alternatives: In her room she has a lot of books.

items.answer: Every student in my class has a phone.
items.audioText: Every student in my class has a phone.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Every student in my
hints.en: The first half: Every student in my

explanation.he: every + שם עצם ביחיד + פועל ביחיד: Every student has. all, many, most באים עם רבים: All students have.
explanation.en: every + singular noun + singular verb. all, many, most take plurals.

alternatives: In my class every student has a phone.

items.answer: I have less money than you.
items.audioText: I have less money than you.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I have less

explanation.he: השוואה עם דבר שלא סופרים: less. עם נספרים: fewer (fewer books). least הוא סופרלטיב.
explanation.en: Compare uncountable nouns with less, countable with fewer. least is a superlative.

alternatives: You have less money than I.

items.answer: Would you like some tea?
items.audioText: Would you like some tea?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Would you like

explanation.he: בשאלה רגילה any, אבל בהצעה או בקשה some: Would you like some tea?
explanation.en: In normal questions use any, but in offers and requests use some.

items.answer: My brother is taller than me.
items.audioText: My brother is taller than me.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My brother is

explanation.he: שם תואר קצר: er + than. taller than. לא מוסיפים more למילה עם er.
explanation.en: Short adjective: -er + than. Never more with -er.

items.answer: This test is easier than the last one.
items.audioText: This test is easier than the last one.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This test is easier
hints.en: The first half: This test is easier

explanation.he: easy → easier. מילה בשתי הברות שמסתיימת ב־y מקבלת ier, בלי more.
explanation.en: easy → easier. Two-syllable adjectives ending in -y take -ier, without more.

items.answer: Eilat is hotter than Tel Aviv in summer.
items.audioText: Eilat is hotter than Tel Aviv in summer.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Eilat is hotter than
hints.en: The first half: Eilat is hotter than

explanation.he: בהשוואה משתמשים ב־than: hotter than. בעברית 'מ', אבל לא from. וגם לא then (= אז).
explanation.en: Comparisons use than. Hebrew uses מ, but not from. And not then (= after that).

alternatives: In summer Eilat is hotter than Tel Aviv.

items.answer: Today is better than yesterday.
items.audioText: Today is better than yesterday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Today is better

explanation.he: good → better → the best. Today is better than yesterday.
explanation.en: good → better → the best.

items.answer: This is the best movie I have ever seen.
items.audioText: This is the best movie I have ever seen.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This is the best movie
hints.en: The first half: This is the best movie

explanation.he: סופרלטיב של good הוא the best. the best movie I have ever seen.
explanation.en: The superlative of good is the best.

items.answer: Math is the most difficult subject for me.
items.audioText: Math is the most difficult subject for me.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Math is the most
hints.en: The first half: Math is the most

explanation.he: מילה ארוכה: the most + שם תואר. וחייבים the לפני סופרלטיב.
explanation.en: Long adjective: the most + adjective. A superlative needs the.

alternatives: For me, math is the most difficult subject.
Math is, for me, the most difficult subject.

items.answer: My bag is heavier than yours.
items.audioText: My bag is heavier than yours.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My bag is

explanation.he: heavy → heavier, כמו easy → easier.
explanation.en: heavy → heavier, like easy → easier.

alternatives: Yours is heavier than my bag.

items.answer: The weather today is worse than yesterday.
items.audioText: The weather today is worse than yesterday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The weather today is
hints.en: The first half: The weather today is

explanation.he: bad → worse → the worst. עם than משתמשים בהשוואה: worse than.
explanation.en: bad → worse → the worst. With than, use the comparative: worse than.

alternatives: Today the weather is worse than yesterday.
The weather is worse today than yesterday.

items.answer: She is as tall as her mother.
items.audioText: She is as tall as her mother.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She is as tall
hints.en: The first half: She is as tall

explanation.he: as + שם תואר + as = באותה מידה: as tall as. לא as tall than.
explanation.en: as + adjective + as = equal: as tall as.

alternatives: Her mother is as tall as she.

items.answer: The more you practise, the better you get.
items.audioText: The more you practise, the better you get.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The more you practise,
hints.en: The first half: The more you practise,

explanation.he: The more ..., the better ... = ככל ש... כך... שני החלקים בהשוואה.
explanation.en: The more ..., the better ...: both parts use a comparative.

items.answer: Of all my friends, Yoni is the funniest.
items.audioText: Of all my friends, Yoni is the funniest.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Of all my friends,
hints.en: The first half: Of all my friends,

explanation.he: כשמשווים לקבוצה: סופרלטיב. funny → the funniest (y הופך ל־i).
explanation.en: Compared with a group: superlative. funny → the funniest.

alternatives: Yoni is the funniest of all my friends.

items.answer: The cat is licking its paw.
items.audioText: The cat is licking its paw.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The cat is

explanation.he: its (בלי גרש) = שלו/שלה לדבר או חיה. it's (עם גרש) = it is.
explanation.en: its (no apostrophe) = belonging to it. it's = it is.

items.answer: It's going to rain today.
items.audioText: It's going to rain today.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: It's going to

explanation.he: It's = It is. It's going to rain. Its בלי גרש הוא שייכות.
explanation.en: It's = It is. Its without an apostrophe shows possession.

alternatives: Today it's going to rain.

items.answer: My friends left their bags in the classroom.
items.audioText: My friends left their bags in the classroom.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My friends left their
hints.en: The first half: My friends left their

explanation.he: their = שלהם. there = שם / יש. they're = they are.
explanation.en: their = belonging to them. there = in that place. they're = they are.

alternatives: In the classroom my friends left their bags.

items.answer: I hurt myself while I was playing football.
items.audioText: I hurt myself while I was playing football.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I hurt myself while
hints.en: The first half: I hurt myself while

explanation.he: I hurt myself = נפגעתי (פגעתי בעצמי). myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, themselves.
explanation.en: When you do something to yourself: myself, yourself, himself...

alternatives: While I was playing football, I hurt myself.

items.answer: The boys made the cake by themselves.
items.audioText: The boys made the cake by themselves.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The boys made the
hints.en: The first half: The boys made the

explanation.he: they → themselves. theirselves לא קיים. by themselves = לבד, בלי עזרה.
explanation.en: they → themselves. theirselves does not exist.

items.answer: He taught himself to play the guitar.
items.audioText: He taught himself to play the guitar.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He taught himself to
hints.en: The first half: He taught himself to

explanation.he: he → himself. hisself לא קיים. He taught himself = הוא לימד את עצמו.
explanation.en: he → himself. hisself does not exist.

items.answer: Is this pen yours or mine?
items.audioText: Is this pen yours or mine?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Is this pen

explanation.he: כשאין שם עצם אחרי: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs. my בא רק לפני שם עצם: my pen.
explanation.en: With no noun after it: mine, yours, his. my comes only before a noun.

alternatives: Is this pen mine or yours?

items.answer: Dana and I went to the cinema.
items.audioText: Dana and I went to the cinema.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Dana and I went
hints.en: The first half: Dana and I went

explanation.he: בנושא משתמשים ב־I: Dana and I went. אם מורידים את Dana, ברור שאומרים I went ולא me went.
explanation.en: In the subject, use I: Dana and I went. Without Dana you say I went, not me went.

items.answer: There are many reasons to learn English.
items.audioText: There are many reasons to learn English.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: There are many reasons
hints.en: The first half: There are many reasons

explanation.he: There are = יש. their = שלהם. they're = they are.
explanation.en: There are = there exist. their = belonging to them. they're = they are.

items.answer: There is a cat under the table.
items.audioText: There is a cat under the table.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: There is a cat
hints.en: The first half: There is a cat

explanation.he: יש = there is (יחיד) / there are (רבים). בעברית 'יש', אבל באנגלית לא משתמשים ב־have או it has.
explanation.en: יש = there is (singular) / there are (plural). Not have or it has.

alternatives: Under the table there is a cat.

items.answer: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
items.audioText: Are there any eggs in the fridge?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Are there any eggs
hints.en: The first half: Are there any eggs

explanation.he: בשאלה מחליפים את הסדר: Are there any eggs? (רבים).
explanation.en: In questions, change the order: Are there any eggs?

items.answer: There is some water on the floor.
items.audioText: There is some water on the floor.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: There is some water
hints.en: The first half: There is some water

explanation.he: דבר שלא סופרים (water, money, information) הולך עם there is.
explanation.en: Uncountable nouns take there is.

alternatives: On the floor there is some water.

items.answer: Three children are playing in the garden.
items.audioText: Three children are playing in the garden.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Three children are playing
hints.en: The first half: Three children are playing

explanation.he: child → children. children כבר רבים, ולכן לא מוסיפים s.
explanation.en: child → children. It is already plural, so no -s.

alternatives: In the garden three children are playing.

items.answer: One mouse, two mice.
items.audioText: One mouse, two mice.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: mouse → mice. גם louse → lice.
explanation.en: mouse → mice.

alternatives: Two mice, one mouse.

items.answer: I brushed my teeth before bed.
items.audioText: I brushed my teeth before bed.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I brushed my

explanation.he: tooth → teeth, foot → feet, goose → geese.
explanation.en: tooth → teeth, foot → feet.

alternatives: Before bed I brushed my teeth.

items.answer: One woman, two women.
items.audioText: One woman, two women.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: man → men, woman → women.
explanation.en: man → men, woman → women.

alternatives: Two women, one woman.

items.answer: Can you send me information about the course?
items.audioText: Can you send me information about the course?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Can you send me
hints.en: The first half: Can you send me

explanation.he: information, advice, furniture, homework לא מקבלים s באנגלית, גם אם בעברית יש רבים ('מידע', 'עצות').
explanation.en: information, advice, furniture, homework never take -s in English.

items.answer: We bought new furniture for the living room.
items.audioText: We bought new furniture for the living room.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We bought new furniture
hints.en: The first half: We bought new furniture

explanation.he: furniture = רהיטים, אבל באנגלית זו מילה שלא סופרים. אין furnitures.
explanation.en: furniture is uncountable. There is no furnitures.

alternatives: For the living room we bought new furniture.

items.answer: The farmer has twenty sheep.
items.audioText: The farmer has twenty sheep.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: The farmer has

explanation.he: sheep נשאר sheep גם ברבים, כמו fish ו־deer.
explanation.en: sheep stays sheep in the plural, like fish and deer.

items.answer: Put the knives and forks on the table.
items.audioText: Put the knives and forks on the table.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Put the knives and
hints.en: The first half: Put the knives and

explanation.he: knife → knives, wife → wives, leaf → leaves.
explanation.en: knife → knives, leaf → leaves.

alternatives: Put the forks and knives on the table.

items.answer: He drives very carefully.
items.audioText: He drives very carefully.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: שם תואר מתאר שם עצם (a careful driver). תואר הפועל מתאר פועל (drives carefully). careful + ly = carefully.
explanation.en: An adjective describes a noun. An adverb describes a verb: drives carefully.

items.answer: She speaks English very well.
items.audioText: She speaks English very well.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She speaks English

explanation.he: good → well. She is a good speaker. She speaks well.
explanation.en: good → well.

items.answer: The children played quietly in the garden.
items.audioText: The children played quietly in the garden.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The children played quietly
hints.en: The first half: The children played quietly

explanation.he: תואר פועל מתאר פועל: played quietly.
explanation.en: An adverb describes a verb: played quietly.

alternatives: In the garden the children played quietly.
The children played in the garden quietly.

items.answer: You look sad today. Did something happen?
items.audioText: You look sad today. Did something happen?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You look sad today.
hints.en: The first half: You look sad today.

explanation.he: פעלים כמו look, feel, seem, sound מתארים את האדם, ולכן אחריהם שם תואר: You look sad.
explanation.en: Verbs like look, feel, seem describe the subject, so an adjective follows.

alternatives: Today you look sad. Did something happen?

items.answer: He works very hard.
items.audioText: He works very hard.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: hard + ly לא פירושו 'קשה'. hardly = כמעט לא. He works hard = הוא עובד קשה.
explanation.en: hardly means almost not. He works hard.

items.answer: The test was surprisingly easy, so everyone passed.
items.audioText: The test was surprisingly easy, so everyone passed.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The test was surprisingly
hints.en: The first half: The test was surprisingly

explanation.he: לפני שם תואר משתמשים בתואר הפועל: surprisingly easy, really good, extremely hot.
explanation.en: Before an adjective, use an adverb: surprisingly easy.

items.answer: She runs very fast.
items.audioText: She runs very fast.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: fast הוא גם שם תואר וגם תואר פועל. fastly לא קיים.
explanation.en: fast is both an adjective and an adverb. fastly does not exist.

items.answer: What did you do yesterday?
items.audioText: What did you do yesterday?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: What did you

explanation.he: שאלה בעבר: What + did + you + do? הפועל העיקרי חוזר לבסיס.
explanation.en: Past question: What + did + you + do?

items.answer: Although it was raining, we went to the beach.
items.audioText: Although it was raining, we went to the beach.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Although it was raining, we
hints.en: The first half: Although it was raining, we

explanation.he: although + משפט שלם = למרות ש. despite בא עם שם עצם, ו־However לא מחבר שני חלקים בתוך משפט.
explanation.en: although + clause = even though. despite takes a noun, and However doesn't join two clauses.

alternatives: We went to the beach although it was raining.

items.answer: We went to the beach despite the rain.
items.audioText: We went to the beach despite the rain.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We went to the
hints.en: The first half: We went to the

explanation.he: despite + שם עצם: despite the rain. בעברית 'למרות ה...', ולכן מוסיפים of בטעות. אומרים despite או in spite of.
explanation.en: despite + noun. Say despite or in spite of, never despite of.

alternatives: Despite the rain, we went to the beach.

items.answer: The game was cancelled because of the storm.
items.audioText: The game was cancelled because of the storm.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The game was cancelled
hints.en: The first half: The game was cancelled

explanation.he: because + משפט (because it was stormy). because of + שם עצם (because of the storm).
explanation.en: because + clause; because of + noun.

alternatives: Because of the storm, the game was cancelled.

items.answer: I study hard in order to get a good grade.
items.audioText: I study hard in order to get a good grade.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I study hard in order
hints.en: The first half: I study hard in order

explanation.he: in order to + פועל = כדי ל... I study hard in order to get a good grade.
explanation.en: in order to + verb = for the purpose of.

alternatives: In order to get a good grade, I study hard.

items.answer: I went to the shop to buy some milk.
items.audioText: I went to the shop to buy some milk.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I went to the shop
hints.en: The first half: I went to the shop

explanation.he: מטרה באנגלית: to + פועל (= כדי). בעברית 'בשביל לקנות', אבל לא for buy.
explanation.en: Purpose: to + verb. Not for buy.

alternatives: To buy some milk, I went to the shop.

items.answer: You won't pass the test unless you study.
items.audioText: You won't pass the test unless you study.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: You won't pass the
hints.en: The first half: You won't pass the

explanation.he: unless = אלא אם. You won't pass unless you study = בלי ללמוד, לא עוברים את המבחן.
explanation.en: unless = if not.

alternatives: Unless you study, you won't pass the test.

items.answer: The tickets were expensive. However, we bought them.
items.audioText: The tickets were expensive. However, we bought them.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The tickets were expensive.
hints.en: The first half: The tickets were expensive.

explanation.he: However, בתחילת משפט חדש = עם זאת. Although חייב לחבר שני חלקים באותו משפט. Therefore = לכן.
explanation.en: However, starts a new sentence. Although must join two parts. Therefore = so.

alternatives: The tickets were expensive. We bought them, however.

items.answer: He didn't study at all. Therefore, he failed the exam.
items.audioText: He didn't study at all. Therefore, he failed the exam.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He didn't study at all.
hints.en: The first half: He didn't study at all.

explanation.he: Therefore = לכן, תוצאה. However = עם זאת, ניגוד.
explanation.en: Therefore shows a result. However shows contrast.

alternatives: He didn't study at all. He therefore failed the exam.

items.answer: She got the job despite having no experience.
items.audioText: She got the job despite having no experience.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She got the job
hints.en: The first half: She got the job

explanation.he: despite + שם עצם או ing: despite having no experience. although צריך משפט שלם: although she had no experience.
explanation.en: despite + noun or -ing. although needs a full clause.

alternatives: Despite having no experience, she got the job.

items.answer: Despite the bad weather, the trip was great.
items.audioText: Despite the bad weather, the trip was great.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Despite the bad weather,
hints.en: The first half: Despite the bad weather,

explanation.he: למרות + שם עצם: Despite / In spite of the bad weather.
explanation.en: Contrast + noun: Despite / In spite of.

alternatives: The trip was great despite the bad weather.

items.answer: I like science, but my brother prefers art.
items.audioText: I like science, but my brother prefers art.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I like science, but
hints.en: The first half: I like science, but

explanation.he: but מחבר שני חלקים עם ניגוד: I like science, but my brother prefers art.
explanation.en: but joins two contrasting parts.

alternatives: My brother prefers art, but I like science.

items.answer: He saved money so that he could buy a new bike.
items.audioText: He saved money so that he could buy a new bike.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He saved money so that he
hints.en: The first half: He saved money so that he

explanation.he: so that + משפט עם נושא = כדי ש. in order to + פועל בלבד: in order to buy.
explanation.en: so that + clause with a subject. in order to + base verb only.

items.answer: I agree with you. Homework is important.
items.audioText: I agree with you. Homework is important.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I agree with you.
hints.en: The first half: I agree with you.

explanation.he: I agree. agree הוא פועל, ולכן לא צריך am. בעברית 'אני מסכים/ה' נשמע כמו תיאור, אבל באנגלית זה פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: I agree. agree is a verb, so no am.

alternatives: Homework is important. I agree with you.

items.answer: Russia is the biggest country in the world.
items.audioText: Russia is the biggest country in the world.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Russia is the biggest
hints.en: The first half: Russia is the biggest

explanation.he: big → bigger → the biggest. מכפילים את ה־g.
explanation.en: big → bigger → the biggest. Double the g.

alternatives: The biggest country in the world is Russia.

items.answer: Have you finished cleaning your room?
items.audioText: Have you finished cleaning your room?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Have you finished

explanation.he: finish + ing: Have you finished cleaning?
explanation.en: finish + -ing.

items.answer: I love listening to podcasts.
items.audioText: I love listening to podcasts.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: I love listening

explanation.he: listen to + מה ששומעים: listening to podcasts.
explanation.en: listen to + what you hear.

items.answer: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
items.audioText: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: It's a beautiful

explanation.he: It is ..., isn't it? פועל העזר is, ובשלילה isn't.
explanation.en: It is ..., isn't it?

items.answer: We play basketball on Tuesdays.
items.audioText: We play basketball on Tuesdays.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: We play basketball

explanation.he: הרגל = Present Simple. עם we משתמשים בפועל בסיס: We play. לא מכניסים are לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: A habit uses the Present Simple. With we, use the base verb: We play. No are before a normal verb.

alternatives: On Tuesdays we play basketball.

items.answer: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
items.audioText: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Water boils at

explanation.he: עובדות שתמיד נכונות באות ב־Present Simple. water הוא it, ולכן boils עם s.
explanation.en: Facts that are always true use the Present Simple. water is it, so boils with -s.

items.answer: Tom works in a bank. He is a cashier.
items.audioText: Tom works in a bank. He is a cashier.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Tom works in a bank.
hints.en: The first half: Tom works in a bank.

explanation.he: עבודה קבועה = Present Simple. Tom הוא he, ולכן works. בעברית אומרים "הוא עובד", אבל באנגלית לא מוסיפים is לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: A regular job uses the Present Simple. Tom is he, so works. Do not add is before a normal verb.

alternatives: Tom is a cashier. He works in a bank.

items.answer: He brushes his teeth twice a day.
items.audioText: He brushes his teeth twice a day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He brushes his teeth
hints.en: The first half: He brushes his teeth

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־sh, ch, s, x, o מקבל es: brushes.
explanation.en: Verbs ending in sh, ch, s, x, o take -es: brushes.

alternatives: Twice a day he brushes his teeth.

items.answer: She studies math for two hours every day.
items.audioText: She studies math for two hours every day.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She studies math for
hints.en: The first half: She studies math for

explanation.he: עיצור + y בסוף: מורידים y ומוסיפים ies. study → studies.
explanation.en: Consonant + y: drop y and add -ies. study → studies.

alternatives: Every day she studies math for two hours.
She studies math every day for two hours.

items.answer: My grandmother goes to the market every Friday.
items.audioText: My grandmother goes to the market every Friday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My grandmother goes to
hints.en: The first half: My grandmother goes to

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־o מקבל es: go → goes, do → does.
explanation.en: Verbs ending in o take -es: go → goes, do → does.

alternatives: Every Friday my grandmother goes to the market.

items.answer: She has two brothers. They are both older than her.
items.audioText: She has two brothers. They are both older than her.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She has two brothers. They
hints.en: The first half: She has two brothers. They

explanation.he: have עם he, she, it הופך ל־has. She has two brothers.
explanation.en: have with he, she, it becomes has: She has two brothers.

alternatives: She has two brothers. They both are older than her.

items.answer: The shop closes at nine o'clock every evening.
items.audioText: The shop closes at nine o'clock every evening.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The shop closes at
hints.en: The first half: The shop closes at

explanation.he: the shop הוא it. ב־Present Simple מוסיפים s: closes.
explanation.en: the shop is it. In the Present Simple add -s: closes.

alternatives: Every evening the shop closes at nine o'clock.
The shop closes every evening at nine o'clock.

items.answer: Noa lives in Tel Aviv.
items.audioText: Noa lives in Tel Aviv.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Noa lives in

explanation.he: Noa היא she, ולכן lives עם s. לא מוסיפים is לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: Noa is she, so lives with -s. Do not add is before a normal verb.

items.answer: Every morning, my brother takes the dog for a walk.
items.audioText: Every morning, my brother takes the dog for a walk.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Every morning, my brother takes
hints.en: The first half: Every morning, my brother takes

explanation.he: הרגל = Present Simple. my brother הוא he, ולכן takes.
explanation.en: A habit uses the Present Simple. my brother is he, so takes.

alternatives: My brother takes the dog for a walk every morning.

items.answer: The bus goes past our school every ten minutes.
items.audioText: The bus goes past our school every ten minutes.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The bus goes past our
hints.en: The first half: The bus goes past our

explanation.he: the bus הוא it. go מסתיים ב־o, ולכן מקבל es: goes.
explanation.en: the bus is it. go ends in o, so it takes -es: goes.

alternatives: Every ten minutes the bus goes past our school.

items.answer: Do you like chocolate?
items.audioText: Do you like chocolate?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: שאלה בהווה פשוט: Do / Does + נושא + פועל בסיס. עם you משתמשים ב־Do. בעברית שואלים רק בעזרת הטון, ולכן קל לשכוח את Do.
explanation.en: A Present Simple question: Do / Does + subject + base verb. With you, use Do.

items.answer: Does your brother play the guitar?
items.audioText: Does your brother play the guitar?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Does your brother

explanation.he: עם he, she, it שואלים עם Does: Does your brother play...?
explanation.en: With he, she, it, ask with Does: Does your brother play...?

items.answer: She doesn't eat meat. She is a vegetarian.
items.audioText: She doesn't eat meat. She is a vegetarian.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She doesn't eat meat.
hints.en: The first half: She doesn't eat meat.

explanation.he: שלילה בהווה פשוט: don't / doesn't + פועל בסיס. עם she: doesn't eat.
explanation.en: Present Simple negative: don't / doesn't + base verb. With she: doesn't eat.

alternatives: She is a vegetarian. She doesn't eat meat.

items.answer: Does he live near the school?
items.audioText: Does he live near the school?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Does he live

explanation.he: אחרי does הפועל בצורת הבסיס, בלי s: Does he live...? ה־s כבר נמצאת ב־does.
explanation.en: After does, use the base verb without -s: Does he live...? The -s is already in does.

items.answer: My parents don't watch TV in the morning.
items.audioText: My parents don't watch TV in the morning.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My parents don't watch
hints.en: The first half: My parents don't watch

explanation.he: my parents הם they, ולכן don't + פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: my parents is they, so don't + base verb.

alternatives: In the morning my parents don't watch TV.

items.answer: Where does your aunt work?
items.audioText: Where does your aunt work?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: Where does your

explanation.he: שאלה עם מילת שאלה: Where + does + she + פועל בסיס. your aunt היא she, ולכן does.
explanation.en: Wh- question: Where + does + she + base verb. your aunt is she, so does.

items.answer: My dad doesn't drink coffee.
items.audioText: My dad doesn't drink coffee.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: My dad doesn't

explanation.he: doesn't + פועל בסיס: doesn't drink. ה־s כבר נמצאת ב־doesn't.
explanation.en: doesn't + base verb: doesn't drink. The -s is already in doesn't.

items.answer: What time does the movie start tonight?
items.audioText: What time does the movie start tonight?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: What time does the
hints.en: The first half: What time does the

explanation.he: שאלה עם it: does + פועל בסיס. What time does the movie start?
explanation.en: Question with it: does + base verb. What time does the movie start?

items.answer: Look! The children are playing in the garden.
items.audioText: Look! The children are playing in the garden.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Look! The children are
hints.en: The first half: Look! The children are

explanation.he: פעולה שקורית עכשיו: am / is / are + ing. בעברית אין צורה מיוחדת להווה מתמשך, ולכן קל לבחור play. באנגלית: are playing.
explanation.en: An action happening now: am / is / are + -ing. The children are playing.

items.answer: Shh! The baby is sleeping right now.
items.audioText: Shh! The baby is sleeping right now.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Shh! The baby is
hints.en: The first half: Shh! The baby is

explanation.he: עכשיו = Present Progressive: is sleeping. בלי is המשפט לא שלם.
explanation.en: Now = Present Progressive: is sleeping. Without is the sentence is not complete.

alternatives: Shh! Right now the baby is sleeping.

items.answer: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
items.audioText: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Listen! Someone is knocking
hints.en: The first half: Listen! Someone is knocking

explanation.he: is + פועל + ing: is knocking.
explanation.en: is + verb + -ing: is knocking.

items.answer: It is raining outside, so take an umbrella.
items.audioText: It is raining outside, so take an umbrella.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: It is raining outside,
hints.en: The first half: It is raining outside,

explanation.he: It is raining: is + ing לפעולה שקורית עכשיו.
explanation.en: It is raining: is + -ing for an action happening now.

items.answer: We are waiting for a bus at the moment.
items.audioText: We are waiting for a bus at the moment.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We are waiting for a
hints.en: The first half: We are waiting for a

explanation.he: are + ing: are waiting.
explanation.en: are + -ing: are waiting.

alternatives: At the moment we are waiting for a bus.

items.answer: She is writing a letter to her friend now.
items.audioText: She is writing a letter to her friend now.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She is writing a letter
hints.en: The first half: She is writing a letter

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־e שקטה: מורידים e ומוסיפים ing. write → writing.
explanation.en: Verb ending in silent e: drop e, add -ing. write → writing.

alternatives: Now she is writing a letter to her friend.
She is now writing a letter to her friend.

items.answer: They are swimming in the sea right now.
items.audioText: They are swimming in the sea right now.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: They are swimming in
hints.en: The first half: They are swimming in

explanation.he: מילה קצרה שמסתיימת בעיצור + תנועה + עיצור: מכפילים את העיצור האחרון. swim → swimming.
explanation.en: Short verb ending consonant + vowel + consonant: double the last letter. swim → swimming.

alternatives: Right now they are swimming in the sea.

items.answer: He is sitting on the floor because there are no chairs.
items.audioText: He is sitting on the floor because there are no chairs.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He is sitting on the floor
hints.en: The first half: He is sitting on the floor

explanation.he: sit → sitting: מכפילים את העיצור האחרון.
explanation.en: sit → sitting: double the last consonant.

alternatives: Because there are no chairs, he is sitting on the floor.

items.answer: What are you doing right now?
items.audioText: What are you doing right now?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: What are you

explanation.he: שאלה ב־Present Progressive: What + are + you + ing. do בא רק עם פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: Present Progressive question: What + are + you + -ing. do goes only with a base verb.

items.answer: I know the answer to this question.
items.audioText: I know the answer to this question.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I know the answer
hints.en: The first half: I know the answer

explanation.he: פעלי מצב כמו know, like, want, understand לא באים בדרך כלל ב־ing, גם כשמדברים על עכשיו: I know.
explanation.en: State verbs like know, like, want and understand usually have no -ing form, even about now: I know.

items.answer: This bag belongs to my brother.
items.audioText: This bag belongs to my brother.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: This bag belongs

explanation.he: belong הוא פועל מצב, ולכן Present Simple: This bag belongs to my brother.
explanation.en: belong is a state verb, so use the Present Simple: This bag belongs to my brother.

items.answer: Be quiet, please. I am trying to concentrate.
items.audioText: Be quiet, please. I am trying to concentrate.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Be quiet, please. I
hints.en: The first half: Be quiet, please. I

explanation.he: מנסים להתרכז עכשיו, ולכן am trying. בעברית "אני מנסה" משמש גם להווה מתמשך.
explanation.en: The effort is happening now, so am trying.

alternatives: Please be quiet. I am trying to concentrate.
I am trying to concentrate. Be quiet, please.
I am trying to concentrate. Please be quiet.

items.answer: I think that this plan is a good idea.
items.audioText: I think that this plan is a good idea.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I think that this plan
hints.en: The first half: I think that this plan

explanation.he: think that = דעה, וזה מצב. לכן Present Simple: I think that...
explanation.en: think that = an opinion, which is a state. Use the Present Simple: I think that...

items.answer: She tried to open the window, but it was stuck.
items.audioText: She tried to open the window, but it was stuck.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She tried to open the
hints.en: The first half: She tried to open the

explanation.he: try → tried: מורידים y ומוסיפים ied.
explanation.en: try → tried: drop y, add -ied.

items.answer: We lived in a small village when I was a child.
items.audioText: We lived in a small village when I was a child.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We lived in a small village
hints.en: The first half: We lived in a small village

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־e מקבל רק d: live → lived.
explanation.en: A verb ending in e takes only -d: live → lived.

alternatives: When I was a child, we lived in a small village.

items.answer: Last summer my family moved to Haifa.
items.audioText: Last summer my family moved to Haifa.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Last summer my family
hints.en: The first half: Last summer my family

explanation.he: last summer הוא זמן עבר מוגדר, ולכן Past Simple: moved.
explanation.en: last summer is a finished past time, so use the Past Simple: moved.

alternatives: My family moved to Haifa last summer.

items.answer: Two days ago, I visited my grandparents.
items.audioText: Two days ago, I visited my grandparents.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Two days ago, I
hints.en: The first half: Two days ago, I

explanation.he: עם ago משתמשים ב־Past Simple: visited. Present Perfect לא בא עם זמן עבר מוגדר.
explanation.en: With ago, use the Past Simple: visited. The Present Perfect does not go with a finished time.

alternatives: I visited my grandparents two days ago.

items.answer: We went to the beach last Saturday.
items.audioText: We went to the beach last Saturday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We went to the
hints.en: The first half: We went to the

explanation.he: go → went → gone. בעבר פשוט: went.
explanation.en: go → went → gone. Past Simple: went.

alternatives: Last Saturday we went to the beach.

items.answer: I heard a strange noise last night.
items.audioText: I heard a strange noise last night.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I heard a strange
hints.en: The first half: I heard a strange

explanation.he: hear → heard. ההגייה משתנה: "הרד".
explanation.en: hear → heard. The sound changes too.

alternatives: Last night I heard a strange noise.

items.answer: He left his keys on the bus yesterday.
items.audioText: He left his keys on the bus yesterday.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: He left his keys
hints.en: The first half: He left his keys

explanation.he: leave → left → left.
explanation.en: leave → left → left.

alternatives: Yesterday he left his keys on the bus.

items.answer: The kids drank a lot of water after yesterday's game.
items.audioText: The kids drank a lot of water after yesterday's game.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The kids drank a lot
hints.en: The first half: The kids drank a lot

explanation.he: drink → drank → drunk. כמו swim → swam → swum.
explanation.en: drink → drank → drunk, like swim → swam → swum.

alternatives: After yesterday's game, the kids drank a lot of water.

items.answer: I cut my finger while I was cutting tomatoes.
items.audioText: I cut my finger while I was cutting tomatoes.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I cut my finger while
hints.en: The first half: I cut my finger while

explanation.he: cut → cut → cut. כך גם put, hit, let, cost.
explanation.en: cut → cut → cut. Also put, hit, let, cost.

alternatives: While I was cutting tomatoes, I cut my finger.

items.answer: I felt terrible yesterday, so I stayed in bed.
items.audioText: I felt terrible yesterday, so I stayed in bed.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I felt terrible yesterday, so
hints.en: The first half: I felt terrible yesterday, so

explanation.he: feel → felt. לא לבלבל עם fall → fell.
explanation.en: feel → felt. Do not mix it up with fall → fell.

alternatives: Yesterday I felt terrible, so I stayed in bed.
I felt terrible, so I stayed in bed yesterday.
I felt terrible, so yesterday I stayed in bed.

items.answer: Yesterday Dan told me a funny story.
items.audioText: Yesterday Dan told me a funny story.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Yesterday Dan told me
hints.en: The first half: Yesterday Dan told me

explanation.he: tell → told. אין telled.
explanation.en: tell → told. There is no telled.

alternatives: Dan told me a funny story yesterday.

items.answer: Last night the phone rang three times, but nobody answered.
items.audioText: Last night the phone rang three times, but nobody answered.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Last night the phone rang
hints.en: The first half: Last night the phone rang

explanation.he: ring → rang → rung. בעבר פשוט: rang. rung בא רק אחרי have / had.
explanation.en: ring → rang → rung. The Past Simple is rang. rung comes only after have / had.

alternatives: The phone rang three times last night, but nobody answered.

items.answer: Did you see the match last night?
items.audioText: Did you see the match last night?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Did you see the
hints.en: The first half: Did you see the

explanation.he: אחרי did בא פועל בסיס: Did you see? ה־did כבר נושא את העבר.
explanation.en: After did use the base verb: Did you see? did already carries the past.

items.answer: Where did you go on your vacation last summer?
items.audioText: Where did you go on your vacation last summer?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Where did you go on
hints.en: The first half: Where did you go on

explanation.he: שאלה בעבר: Where + did + you + פועל בסיס. were לא בא עם פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: Past question: Where + did + you + base verb. were does not go with a base verb.

alternatives: Where did you go last summer on your vacation?

items.answer: She didn't write the email.
items.audioText: She didn't write the email.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.en: The first half: She didn't write

explanation.he: didn't + פועל בסיס: didn't write.
explanation.en: didn't + base verb: didn't write.

items.answer: Did they catch the bus on time?
items.audioText: Did they catch the bus on time?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: Did they catch the
hints.en: The first half: Did they catch the

explanation.he: Did + נושא + פועל בסיס: Did they catch...?
explanation.en: Did + subject + base verb: Did they catch...?

items.answer: I didn't know the answer, so I asked my friend.
items.audioText: I didn't know the answer, so I asked my friend.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I didn't know the answer,
hints.en: The first half: I didn't know the answer,

explanation.he: didn't + פועל בסיס: didn't know.
explanation.en: didn't + base verb: didn't know.

items.answer: Who broke the window?
items.audioText: Who broke the window?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

explanation.he: כשמילת השאלה היא הנושא (Who broke?), לא מוסיפים did. משתמשים בפועל בעבר: broke.
explanation.en: When the question word is the subject (Who broke?), do not add did. Use the past form: broke.

items.answer: My brother didn't like the movie we saw last night.
items.audioText: My brother didn't like the movie we saw last night.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: My brother didn't like the
hints.en: The first half: My brother didn't like the

explanation.he: שלילה בעבר: didn't + פועל בסיס. wasn't לא בא לפני like.
explanation.en: Past negative: didn't + base verb. wasn't does not go before like.

items.answer: How much did your new shoes cost?
items.audioText: How much did your new shoes cost?

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: How much did your
hints.en: The first half: How much did your

explanation.he: אחרי did בא פועל בסיס: How much did they cost?
explanation.en: After did use the base verb: How much did they cost?

items.answer: This time yesterday, we were sitting on the beach.
items.audioText: This time yesterday, we were sitting on the beach.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: This time yesterday, we were
hints.en: The first half: This time yesterday, we were

explanation.he: פעולה שהייתה באמצע ברגע מסוים בעבר: was / were + ing. עם we: were sitting.
explanation.en: An action in progress at a moment in the past: was / were + -ing. With we: were sitting.

alternatives: We were sitting on the beach this time yesterday.

items.answer: I was watching TV when the lights went out.
items.audioText: I was watching TV when the lights went out.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: I was watching TV when
hints.en: The first half: I was watching TV when

explanation.he: הפעולה הארוכה (watching) נקטעה ע"י פעולה קצרה (went out). הארוכה ב־Past Progressive: I was watching.
explanation.en: The long action was interrupted by a short one. The long one is Past Progressive: I was watching.

alternatives: When the lights went out, I was watching TV.

items.answer: She was riding her bike when she fell.
items.audioText: She was riding her bike when she fell.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: She was riding her
hints.en: The first half: She was riding her

explanation.he: was + ing: was riding. ride מסתיים ב־e, ולכן מורידים אותה.
explanation.en: was + -ing: was riding. ride ends in e, so drop it.

alternatives: When she fell, she was riding her bike.

items.answer: We were waiting for the bus when we saw Tom.
items.audioText: We were waiting for the bus when we saw Tom.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: We were waiting for the
hints.en: The first half: We were waiting for the

explanation.he: were + ing: were waiting. הפעולה הארוכה נקטעה כשראינו את Tom.
explanation.en: were + -ing: were waiting. The long action was interrupted when we saw Tom.

alternatives: When we saw Tom, we were waiting for the bus.

items.answer: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
items.audioText: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: The phone rang while I
hints.en: The first half: The phone rang while I

explanation.he: while בא לפני משפט עם נושא ופועל. during בא רק לפני שם עצם: during the shower. בעברית "בזמן ש" מתאים לשניהם, ולכן מתבלבלים.
explanation.en: while comes before a clause with a subject and verb. during comes only before a noun: during the shower.

alternatives: While I was taking a shower, the phone rang.

items.answer: While we were having lunch, it started to snow.
items.audioText: While we were having lunch, it started to snow.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: While we were having lunch,
hints.en: The first half: While we were having lunch,

explanation.he: While + משפט: While we were having lunch. During + שם עצם: During lunch.
explanation.en: While + clause: While we were having lunch. During + noun: During lunch.

alternatives: It started to snow while we were having lunch.

items.answer: When I arrived, the guests were dancing and laughing.
items.audioText: When I arrived, the guests were dancing and laughing.

instruction.en: Build the sentence from the words

hints.he: החצי הראשון: When I arrived, the guests
hints.en: The first half: When I arrived, the guests

explanation.he: were dancing and laughing: שתי פעולות שהיו באמצע כשהגעתי.
explanation.en: were dancing and laughing: two actions in progress when I arrived.

alternatives: The guests were dancing and laughing when I arrived.
When I arrived, the guests were laughing and dancing.
The guests were laughing and dancing when I arrived.
